brief:
Filmmaker Dror Dayan examines state repression in his documentary about German authorities shutting down a Palestine conference in Berlin, drawing parallels to historical censorship under Nazi rule. The Electronic Intifada reported on the film and Dayan's analysis of the ban.

The discussion also covered Israeli election developments and Ansarallah's drone operations in Yemen, according to the outlet's livestream format featuring commentary from Ali Abunimah and Jon Elmer.
dek: Dror Dayan on his film about the ban on the Berlin Palestine conference. Ali Abunimah on Israeli elections. Jon Elmer on Ansarallah’s drones in Yemen.
title: German authorities ban Berlin Palestine conference, drawing Nazi-era comparisons
